summary: Reservation claims for Civil Judge posts; applicants from OBC-NCL, MBC-NCL, EWS categories with post-deadline caste certificates; certificates dated after August 31, 2021 cutoff despite eligibility; High Court dismissal of writ petitions challenged; mandatory production of category certificates on demand, not at application stage; first-time inclusion of MBC-NCL/EWS categories; validity of late certificates for reserved category consideration; standard: eligibility verification at time of appointment vs. application deadline; interim permission to appear in interviews but denial of category benefits; merit list discrepancies between open and reserved categories.
final_judgment: Leave granted; matter remanded to High Court to reconsider reservation claims based on certificate validity timing; interim status maintained pending fresh determination.
